title: Seventh Pylon and Cachette Court
summary: Thutmose III’s southern gateway is associated with the court where Legrain discovered the great statue cache in 1903.
orientation: On the southern axis, north of the Eighth Pylon.

claims.text: Thutmose III’s southern gateway is associated with the court where Legrain discovered the great statue cache in 1903.
Its south face presents the king defeating captives; this is formal royal victory imagery, not a photograph of an event.
The buried sculptures represent a secondary deposit; the discovery location must be distinguished from their original display positions.

caveats: Field access and demonstration viewpoints are unverified; this is an editorial research draft.
